label: About
title: About Torn Orange Ostinato Wall
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 142 recent saved-signal files and 105 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around D-Leria, Translate // AMTK+005 split 12inch and Eliane Radigue - In Memoriam-Ostinato / Danse des Dakinis, plus 7 more. A source image from musigrab.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Torn Orange Ostinato Wall: Torn poster wall, flat-on camera plate grammar: a huge burnt-orange record-label circle is ripped into charcoal vinyl margins, pale abstract zero-and-five-like masses buried under paper tears, tiny illegible lower ink ticks, black spindle puncture. Behind it, a dusty mauve concentric labyrinth fragment presses throu... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against burnt-orange circular paper rim, mauve radial glyph underprint, and vertical black torn pressure strip.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
